opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases); most grants below £300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations hosting the grant. Will not fund individuals without formal employment/contractual relationship with the host institution, projects led by schools or FE colleges, projects led by undergraduates or master's students, PhD fees, or projects led by organisations not based in the UK (exceptional overseas cases possible).
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five interconnected priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund (RDUK)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities. Partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society. 2026 priority theme: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK. One deadline a year in Autumn.
